brief:
A week after flooding submerged displacement camps in Gaza, families remain without adequate shelter, Shehab Wire reported. The deluge destroyed thousands of tents housing displaced Palestinians, leaving them exposed to the elements as winter approaches.

Before relief supplies could reach displaced children, Israeli forces demolished homes and restricted the entry of winter materials into Gaza, compounding the humanitarian crisis. Families face a dual catastrophe: losing their temporary shelters to floodwaters while occupation authorities block reconstruction aid and protective equipment.

title: Gaza families search for shelter after flood destroys camps
